body:
Adds `research/autocorr-twin`: exact AR(1) and M/M/1 variance inflation for a single long digital-twin run, naive-interval coverage (9–53% for M/M/1 waits at n=10^4), false SLA certification (26% naive vs 4.8% batch means), exact run lengths, and batch-means repair including its failure when batches are shorter than the correlation time (0.535 coverage at phi=0.99).

- 8 unit tests pass; `experiments/results.txt` is the seeded output of `experiments/run.py`.
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
- The M/M/1 asymptotic-variance formula is cited (Daley 1968; Whitt 1989), not derived; simulation agrees within estimate noise (stated in the paper).
